“When elegance and modernity meet an old mansion…”

The Urban Hotel is originally the home of a former spinner, Monsieur Pouillet, at the time when Lille and its metropolis prospered thanks to the weaving industry.

Located 2 km from the centre, 1.4 km from the Grand Palais and 2.5 km from Old Lille, take advantage of our free parking to walk, by metro (Porte de Valencienne 4 minutes, directly connecting Lille-Europe and Lille-Flandres stations) or by bike thanks to the V'lille station, which is also less than 4 minutes away.

Our rooms, renovated in 2022, invite you to a moment of rest after a day of tourism or work & before a tasty breakfast where we prefer local products.

Our rooms will seduce you with their sleek design as well as their comfort and amenities.

The Rococo Restaurant offers creative cuisine based on local products offered by our Chef Jean-François and his team.

hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Appart-Hôtel Appart’City Lille Euralille offers comfortable, 3-star self-contained accommodation with private parking and free Wi-Fi. The reception is open 24/7.
Our apartments feature a sleeping area, a private bathroom, a workspace, and a fully equipped kitchen with two cooking hobs, a microwave, a refrigerator, and dishware. From double studios to spacious one-bedroom family apartments, our accommodations are perfectly suited for both business and family stays.
Whether for a short or long stay, our residence also offers accommodation solutions for students, many of whom choose to experience the vibrant and festive atmosphere of the city each year.
For added comfort, our team recommends our à la carte services, such as daily housekeeping or laundry.
We’ll be happy to welcome your pet!
hostInfo.ownerInfo: They say you can't have it all. Comfort or adventure ? Work or relaxation ? Freedom or hotel services ? What if we replaced “or” with “and” ? We've reinvented hospitality to offer you a flexible, comfortable and perfectly suited option for all your stays, whether for business or leisure.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Those looking to try local culinary specialities can ask our team for advice, who will be delighted to point out the best traditional restaurants in central Lille. Come and fall in love with Lille and its Flemish façades, belfry and the opera house building. Just 2 minutes on foot from your apartment, the Romarin tram stop guarantees easy access to Lille Europe and Lille Flandres stations.

hostInfo.welcomeMessage:
Our hotel residence offers you a wide choice of 113 flats, from studios to 3 rooms, all fully furnished and equipped : kitchen with crockery and cutlery, desk area, shower room and flat-screen TV. 

We provide towels and sheets. Beds are ready when you arrive. 

You will appreciate the facilities and services provided free of charge, such as WiFi internet access, free luggage storage (open from 7am to 12pm and from 1pm to 10pm on weekdays and from 8am at weekends) and weekly housekeeping.

A number of additional services are available to make your stay as pleasant as possible :

- Continental buffet breakfast (pastries, cereals, juice, cheese, etc.)
- Private, secure parking (must be booked in advance)
- Laundry facilities 

The establishment is not accessible to people with reduced mobility (PRM).
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
Here you will meet a dynamic, cosmopolitan team who are deeply committed to offering you the best possible experience.

We hope you will feel at home here, surrounded by all the attention and comfort you deserve.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo:
The Apparthotel Séjours & Affaires Lille Europe is ideally located in the city centre, between Lille-Flandres and Lille-Europe train stations, close to the main roads and business centres.

Lille, the most Flemish of French cities, will win you over with its colourful architecture and warm welcome. At the heart of the Euroregion, the capital of Nord-Pas-de-Calais has everything you need for a successful stay, from its historic heritage and great museums, such as the Palais des Beaux-Arts, to its attractive shops and tasty cuisine.

Old Lille and the Grand Place are must-sees !

Don't hesitate to ask for our welcome guide when you arrive to get the best addresses in Lille.

items.description:
ibis Lille Centre Grand Place is located in the heart of Lille’s old town, just 200 metres from Treille Cathedral and 1 km from the Palais des Beaux Arts. It offers a 24-hour reception and rooms with city views.

Our hotel have a private car park. The booking is MANDATORY and subject to availability. It's 5 minutes walk from the hotel. The parking cost 15€. the spot is available from midday on the arrival day until midday on the departure day. To book a spot please contact the hotel directly. Tha payment will be due at your arrival.

The rooms at ibis Lille Centre Grand Place also feature free Wi-Fi access and a flat-screen TV with cable channels. The en suite bathroom is complete with free toiletries and a hairdryer.

A buffet breakfast composed of sweet and savoury dishes such as eggs, fruit salad, yogurts and juices is served every day. Pastries baked on site and fresh French Madeleine cakes are also on offer, as well as a hot beverage and a piece of fruit to take away. Outside of regular breakfast hours guests can also enjoy a lighter option, available from 04:00. Guests can download newspapers for free in the hotel.

Lille Grand Palais is 1.3 km from the property, while Nouveau Siècle Convention Centre is 300 metres away. Gare Lille Flandres Train Station is 600 metres away and Gare Lille Europe Train Station is 1 km away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.5 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

items.description:
Offering a terrace, Eklo Hotels Lille is set in Lille in the Nord-Pas-de-Calais Region, 2 km from Zénith of Lille. Lille Europe Train Station is 2.7 km away and Lille Flandres Train Station is 2.6 km away.

All rooms are fitted with a private bathroom. Other services (toiletries and late check-out) are available at the hotel for an extra fee.

You will find a 24-hour front desk and a bar at the property. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant called Barbapizz', which serves pizzas and salads. A self-service continental breakfast is available daily at an extra cost.

A shared kitchen, a library as well as board games and a table football are at guests' disposal. Bicycle rental and electric charging stations for cars are available at an extra cost. The nearest airport is Lille Airport, 7 km from the property.  Free private parking is available on site.
